summary: Completed BCE-MAX x4.1 compliance testing for BIONIC V8. Session persistence, corridors generation, zones auto-load, layers default, and 2km box all verified. Minor issues found with corridor generation in small areas.

minor.issue: Corridors array missing when zones are only in single layer type (e.g., only 'trajets' zones). This happens in small geographic areas where exclusion filtering eliminates zones from other layers.
minor.root_cause: Corridor 10X algorithm only connects zones from DIFFERENT functional layer types. When all zones are from the same layer (e.g., only trajets), no corridors are generated.
minor.workaround: Use larger bounds or ensure multiple zone types exist. The algorithm works correctly when zones exist in 2+ different layers.

minor.impact: Weather data shows fallback to Open-Meteo which sometimes returns 429 rate limiting

integration_issues.issue: Shows 'ESPÈCE' generic label instead of selected species name after session restore
integration_issues.note: The species IS correctly persisted in localStorage, only the button label display is affected

passed_tests: Session persistence: localStorage key 'bionic_session_bce_max_v4' saves position, species, layers, waypointId, zoom on interaction
Session restore: injected session correctly restores position (lat, lng, zoom), species, layers config, waypointId
Corridors generation: POST /api/v1/bionic/organic-zones with waypoint_center returns corridors when zones exist in multiple layers (20 corridors with 50 zones across 5 layers)
Corridors display: CorridorStatsPanel shows corridor data (2 corridors, 2.4km distance) when available
Auto-load zones: zones load automatically on /mon-territoire page without user interaction (3 zones displayed)
All layers active: LAYERS tab shows 13+ layers active by default (13 confirmed)
2km box visible: Yellow dashed square visible around the waypoint at coordinates (46.8068, -71.1118)
Biological season parameter accepted in API
action_items: Configure OWM_API_KEY in backend/.env for weather API (currently returns 500)
Consider updating corridor algorithm to generate intra-layer corridors when cross-layer connections are not possible
critical_code_review_comments: zone_engine_core_v2.py: Corridor 10X algorithm at line 107-127 only has cross-layer pairs defined. Consider adding same-layer corridor generation for areas with limited zone diversity.
seed_data_creation: Used existing waypoint 'test' at (46.8068, -71.1118) with ID 69b1615f6bc3d6e77e14fde8
